plan.title: Fitness Programme Impact Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of participant growth and performance changes from baseline to endline

panels.title: Total participants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM "baseline" UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM "endline"

panels.title: Average height gain by location
panels.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT b."Child ID", b."Location", b."Height cm" AS h1, e."Height cm" AS h2 FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"), gains AS (SELECT "Location", AVG(h2 - h1) AS avg_gain FROM joined WHERE h2 IS NOT NULL AND h1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT "Location", avg_gain FROM gains

panels.title: Average sit-ups improvement by coach
panels.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT b."Child ID", b."Coach", b."Sit ups" AS s1, e."Sit ups" AS s2 FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"), gains AS (SELECT "Coach", AVG(s2 - s1) AS avg_gain FROM joined WHERE s2 IS NOT NULL AND s1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT "Coach", avg_gain FROM gains

panels.title: Top 10 individual height improvements
panels.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT b."Child ID", b."Child name", b."Location", b."Height cm" AS h1, e."Height cm" AS h2 FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"), gains AS (SELECT "Child name", "Location", (h2 - h1) AS improvement FROM joined WHERE h2 IS NOT NULL AND h1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT * FROM gains

plan.narrative: The programme engaged {{p1}} unique children across multiple locations. Analysis of physical metrics reveals significant growth, with the average height increase varying by region, led by {{p2}} in the top-performing location. Strength improvements were also notable, with coaches like {{p3}} showing the highest average gains in sit-ups among their assigned groups. Individual success stories highlight the programme's effectiveness, with the top performer achieving a height increase of {{p4}}.
